question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT rac.year, r.constructor_id, SUM(r.points) as constructor_points
    FROM results r
    JOIN races rac ON r.race_id = rac.race_id
    WHERE rac.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY rac.year, r.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(r.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT year, MIN(constructor_points) as min_points
    FROM constructor_season_points
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT mpps.year, mpps.min_points
FROM min_points_per_season mpps
WHERE mpps.year = 2001
